description: This file defines a DialogFragment class 'PinnedAppPickerDialog' that displays a list of apps for the user to pick from, specifically for pinning apps to the home screen in an Android multi-display launcher setup. It includes an interface 'AppPickedCallback' to notify when an app has been selected.

classes.name: PinnedAppPickerDialog
classes.description: A DialogFragment that shows a grid of apps for the user to select and pin to the home screen.

classes.name: AppPickedCallback
classes.description: Interface for callback when an app is selected from the picker dialog.

methods.name: PinnedAppPickerDialog
methods.description: Default constructor for the dialog fragment.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Creates a new instance of PinnedAppPickerDialog with specified adapter and callback.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the dialog's layout from XML.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Initializes the grid view and sets up click handler for app selection.
